$\blueD{40\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{84}$ is the same as $\blueD{40\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{84}$.

To solve $\blueD{40\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{84}$, we need to convert $\blueD{40\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{40\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{40}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{40\div 100=0.4}$.

 $\blueD{40\%= \dfrac{40}{100} = 0.4}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{40\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{84}&=\blueD{\dfrac{40}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{84}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.4}\cdot\maroonD{84}\\\\
&=33.6
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

$40\cdot 84=3{,}360$

The expression $40\cdot 84$ is **not** equivalent to $40\%$ of $84$.

$0.4\div 84\approx 0.00014$

The expression $0.4\div 84$ is **not** equivalent to $40\%$ of $84$.

$84\div 40=2.1$

The expression $84\div 40$ is **not** equivalent to $40\%$ of $84$.

The options that have the same value as $40\%$ of $84$ are:

- $\dfrac{40}{100}\cdot 84$
- $0.4\cdot 84$
